(1) or a person appointed to act as the Chairman
or a member of any such Commission, shall be
removed  except  as  provided  for  in  the
Constitution or in any written law, and where
there  is  no  such  provision,  such  person  shall
be removed by the President only with the prior
approval of the Council.
